verdict: Organic signals softening across all entities; paid channels remain inactive.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, your Google Business Profile listings were the sole source of inbound activity, delivering a combined 395 actions — 14 calls, 293 direction requests, and 88 web clicks — over 28 days, with no paid spend on Meta or Google Ads. GBP engagement dropped sharply week-over-week at both Forte Precision Metals (−42%) and Advance Grinding Services (−43%), while O'Hare Precision Metals bucked that trend with a 25% week-over-week GBP increase, though its organic search clicks fell 39% in the same window. The declines at period-end appear tied to reduced search visibility, with zero paid channels in place to backstop organic softness. Site reindexing and outreach sequences are in motion with a target of being live by end of October, which should help stabilize visibility heading into the next period.
